title: Knitwear manufacturer in Southern Europe for 300-piece runs
description: We are adding four knitwear styles to the permanent collection and need a factory that treats a 300-piece order as a real order. Fabric comes from our existing mills; we need cut-make-trim plus finishing, with development samples inside two weeks.

title: Recycled concrete supplier for a Fribourg school project
description: Public tender for a 4,800 m² primary school. We need structural precast with declared recycled aggregate content above 55%, delivered within 200 km of Fribourg, and an EPD we can put straight into the material passport.

title: GOTS-certified jersey mill for a repeat programme
description: Two of our brand customers want the same jersey base four times a year. We are looking for a knitting mill that can hold yarn lots and guarantee shade continuity across drops, rather than requoting every season.

title: Low-carbon insulation for 4,200 m² of timber frame
description: Timber frame residential project in Vaud. We need bio-based batts with a published EPD, thermal conductivity at or below 0.040 W/mK, and a documented end-of-life route. Mineral wool will not clear our material passport requirements.
skills: Compostable or recyclable end of life

title: Garment factories with cutting-room waste to divert
description: We buy post-industrial cutting waste by composition and colour. If your factory currently pays for disposal, we will collect from 500 kg and pay per tonne on clean single-composition lots. Looking for four to six regular partners in Iberia.

title: Certification partner for demountable glazing EPD
description: Our demountable spacer system has no existing category rule that covers reglazing as a service life extension. We are looking for a certification body or LCA consultancy willing to develop the methodology with us and stand behind the result.
